notes.title: It's Official... Night Stones is Steam Deck Verified
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone! Valve has completed their testing of Night Stones and has officially declared it to be [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b]. Thanks to all the players who played the game on their Deck on my world alone. I appreciate your trust. And now I'm super pumped to see more players enjoy my game on the Deck. As always, any questions or comments, please let me know on the Steam Discussion board or [url=https://discord.com/invite/eaGcV6rfKQ]Discord[/url]. Thanks for being amazing, everyone.

Ryan

notes.title: Update notes for Dec 5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This release improves loading performance to reduce visual stutters when exploring. I hope you enjoy smooth experience :)

Ryan

notes.title: Improved Camera and a World Map... Oh My!
notes.notes:
You guys asked and I listened. The most common complaints about the game were the camera and the lack of world map. The lastest update has addressed these issues and I hope you think this makes the game more fun. Thanks for your help making the game better. Please keep the feedback coming!

Here are some details about the changes (version 1.0.14 will be displayed in the lower left corner of the title screen):

[list]
[*] A world map is now available. It's an item you'll need to find in the world but it becomes available very early in the game.
[*] Full manual controls are now availble if you want to control the camera yourself. Please see the Gameplay section of the Settings menu to change the camera controls.
[*] I've improved the camera movement regardless of what type of camera you are using (manual or automatic) to give you a clearer view of the player if they are blocked by terrain.
[/list]

I hope like the changes. Any comments or questions, feel free to let me know! The fastest way to contact me is through [url=https://discord.com/invite/eaGcV6rfKQ]Discord [/url]but I'll repsond wherever you want to leave a comment.

Thanks for being helpful, everyone!
Ryan

notes.title: Update notes for Dec 3

Have fun!

notes.title: Night Stones Plays Great on the Steam Deck
notes.notes:
Hi All!

Steam Deck verification requires a manual test by Steam. Steam is unable to test games for this verification until the game has proven itself it in market.

I look forward to receiving Steam Deck verification shortly after release. In the meantime, you'll need to take my word for it (and the word of the hundreds of players who played the demo on the Steam Deck). Night Stones is fully functional and fully amazing on the Steam Deck. 

Thanks for understanding.
Ryan

notes.title: Night Stones releases November 11
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Thanks for your amazing patience and kindness while I develop Night Stones. I'm excited to announce that the game will release November 11 @ 6pm PST. Thanks to all the amazing support you've given me to make this game far better than my wildest expectations. You guys are truly awesome.

-Ryan

notes.title: Play Night Stones anywhere with Cloud Save
notes.notes: Cloud Save is now available on all versions of Night Stones. So, if you are looking to play on your Steam Deck and then later on your PC, you are in luck. Have fun!

notes.title: New Demo Content
notes.notes:
There are many new regions and features in the demo since the last update. You can unlock the boat and sail around the world. With the boat unlocked, you can finally sail through storms that were previously blocking your path.

With the boat, you can also explore the new region: Winterspire Peak. And the cave atop it: Tombs of Time.

If you're a Kickstarter backer, your name is now in the credits and you watch them from the title screen. If you are a Diamond Soul backer, please check your email for instructions for building your monument in the Cave of Souls.

Any issues, please let me know!

Ryan

notes.title: Night Stones Played by the Dev
notes.notes:
Night Stones is an open world adventure game rich in quests, exploration, and story.

After dreaming of a world where you can fly and change day to night in an instant, you awake to find yourself still there. Now it’s up to you to discover the secrets of this world and find a way back home. Follow the trails or explore the wilderness as you meet the new characters, discover hidden treasures, and unlock new abilities. This world is full of beauty but also danger so explore at your own risk!

notes.title: Night Stones is now FUNDED on Kickstarter!!! 🎉
notes.notes:
[h3]Thank You![/h3]
I'm thrilled to share that thanks to all of you, our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/advancenine/night-stones-an-open-world-adventure]Kickstarter campaign[/url] has been successfully funded!

My dream open-world adventure game is one step closer to reality. I'm deeply moved and grateful to have such a supportive community following the development of the game. Your support is shaping the world of Night Stones into something truly special.

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
Moving forward, I'm committed to keeping you updated with all the developments. Expect continued regular updates, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes content as I pour my heart out into creating a game that I hope you'll love.

[h3]Alpha Testing - Soon![/h3]
I'm hard at work on the first alpha demo, which will be made available exclusively for the Kickstarter backers on the Alpha Stone tier and up. I can't wait to get amazing feedback from all of you!

[h3]You Rule[/h3]
Once again, thank you for being the best part of Night Stones. Your support means the world to me, and I can't wait to continue this adventure together.

Until next time,
Ryan
